approval: INTERPRETATION 1..7 approved by Sanaa 2026-08-21 on the team's recommendation, each in the draft's recommended reading

grid.rule: three levels at nominal ratio 1.6 in radiating-face edge count, Roache GCI at Fs = 1.25 on the finest, using analyse_t1c.py's gci imported from T1_runs; a graded row whose triple is not CONVERGING (OSCILLATORY, STAGNANT, DIVERGENT or EXACT) returns NOT A RESULT, never PASS; a row any of whose levels is not iteratively CONVERGED returns NOT A RESULT before the triple is even formed

sigma.graded_against: sigma_OF, rebuilt from the k, h, c that etc/controlDict carries and READ from that file by exact_t10a.py

spheres.qr_openfoam_sign: qr is the net flux INTO the wall (viewFactor.C: C q = b with b_i = -sigma T_i^4 + sum_j F_ij sigma T_j^4): registered qr is -3374.471705 on inner and +843.617926 on outer

hottel_2d_reported_only.status: identity under Charter 2a (reference and tool share the crossed-strings closed form): REPORTED, never gated, not counted

B2.quantity: box x-walls net leaving flux, mean of both [W/m2]

B3.quantity: box y-walls net leaving flux, mean of both [W/m2]

sigma.handling: graded against sigma_OF; not a floor in practice

sphere_faceting.handling: O(h^2), read from mesh areas at every level, inside the ladder, not a floor

quadrature.handling: GaussQuadTol 0.01, distTol 8, alpha 0.21, intTol 0.01 held fixed across the ladder; measured by the raw row-sum defect of the written F at every level and by the finest-level GaussQuadTol 0.001 twins S_f_q, B_f_q; REGISTERED CONDITION: if a row's armed band is smaller than the relative change the twin produces on that row, the row is REPORTED AND NOT GRADED, verdict GATE REACHED

smoothing.handling: graded with smoothing false; smoothing true twins S_f_s, B_f_s REPORTED

truncation.handling: none; both geometries are closed and exact

discrimination.rule: a row is graded only if its armed band is less than one tenth of its C2 departure; otherwise REPORTED, GATE REACHED, not counted

guards.iterative_convergence: qr on every viewFactorWall patch at the last two written checkpoints must be identical value for value (max change 0.0); the zero is controlled by planting 1.234e-03 W/m2 into a scratch copy of the earlier checkpoint by line index and reading it back off disk; a level that is not CONVERGED makes every row using it NOT A RESULT

closure.referent: |c_raw - c_F| where c_raw = |sum_f A_f qr_f| / sum_f |A_f qr_f| from the solver's written qr and c_F is the same quantity from the comparator's own radiosity solve on the written F with the same areas and emissivities; a run whose closure departs from what its own view-factor matrix implies by more than 1e-2 is VOID and every row using it is NOT A RESULT; c_raw is ALWAYS printed beside the written F's row-sum defect, and c_raw > 1e-2 is flagged REPORTED
closure.why_this_referent: INTERPRETATION 6 approved 1e-2 and asked for the number to be revisited once the first level's row-sum defect was known, before any graded solve. MEASURED at build (viewFactorsGen, no solve, 2026-08-21, second instance) from the written F of every level with smoothing false: max |sum_j F_ij - 1| per patch is 0.11-0.48 % on the inner sphere, 4.3-4.8 % on the outer sphere AT EVERY LEVEL (the fixed quadrature tolerance does not converge, as registered), 1.9-3.9 % on the box patches, 2.7-3.3 % on H_2d. A raw-closure threshold of 1e-2 would therefore void a correct run for the utility's own quadrature defect, which the ladder and the GaussQuadTol twins already measure. The guard's job is to withdraw a RUN whose assembly or addressing is broken (Charter 2c GUARD row), and that is what |c_raw - c_F| measures; recorded at freeze, 2026-08-21, with no solve in the tree. The first instance's draft of this entry asserted '2-5 % at the coarse levels' before any build existed; corrected to the measured figures by the second instance before the freeze

guards.row_sums_and_reciprocity: max|sum_j F_ij - 1| per patch and max|A_i F_ij - A_j F_ji| from the written constant/F, REPORTED at every level
guards.mesh_readback: patch areas and vertex radii from constant/polyMesh/points (+faces, boundary): sphere vertices on their radii to 1e-9 relative, box extents exact to 1e-12; refusal on mismatch
guards.stale_write: runner refuses any numeric time directory other than 0; marker refuses final-time fields older than the case's own 0/T (L-143)

C2_box.must: FAIL on every graded box row

C3b.must: FAIL on every graded box row

solver.application: buoyantSimpleFoam (ESI v2606), single region, laminar, g = (0 0 0), every wall fixedValue T, radiationModel viewFactor, useDirectSolver true, nBands 1, solverFreq 1, absorptionEmissionModel none, constantEmissivity true
solver.faceAgglomerate: NOT run (INTERPRETATION 4): finalAgglom absent, identity agglomeration, one radiating face per mesh face; note viewFactor.C ignores the diagonal F_ii, which is exact only for planar (unagglomerated) faces
solver.fluid: carrier only: with every wall T fixed, qr is determined by T, eps and F at the first radiation solve and cannot move afterwards

H_2d.role: T10a-3 2D Hottel rectangle, createViewFactors viewFactorHottel, REPORTED ONLY, not counted

measurement.row_value: area-weighted mean of the written qr over the patch's faces, sign flipped to net LEAVING, areas from constant/polyMesh; B2/B3 are the mean over both walls of the pair, each wall also reported with their difference as a symmetry guard
measurement.attribution_lever: the comparator solves the radiosity system itself (numpy) on the written constant/F with the mesh areas and the dictionary emissivities, in the exact viewFactor.C form, and compares face by face with the solver's qr: python-on-F == solver != exact -> the view factors are wrong; python-on-F != solver -> the assembly or BC is wrong
measurement.convergence: last two written checkpoints of qr compared value for value; never residualControl
